title: A real Ctrl-` pressed while the daemon is stopped for 8 s still gives a terminal that takes keys
why: Lawrence on v2.2.10-opt: Ctrl-` does not work. debug.key skips the window server, the menu and AppKit; this sends the real key.

steps.title: set-up: Go to Home (its menu item); Home's message box has the keyboard
a REAL Ctrl-` on Home (CuaDriver HID key event)
Home: the real Ctrl-` reached cmux and ran New Terminal Tab
Home: a new terminal has the keyboard and the daemon knows it
Home: the typed line runs in the new terminal
the daemon stops for 8 s (SIGSTOP); the real Ctrl-` comes during it
record what has the keyboard before the real Ctrl-`
a REAL Ctrl-` (CuaDriver HID key event)
the real Ctrl-` reached cmux and ran New Terminal Tab (action log, keyboard entrypoint)
a new terminal has the keyboard and the daemon knows it
the typed line runs in the new terminal
